title: SPF decoded
caption: Most SPF fails in the UAE before noon — not because it's weak, but because it's under-applied and never reapplied. A full teaspoon covers your face; most people use a quarter of that. The PA+++ rating (not just SPF 50) is what blocks the UVA rays that drive pigmentation and premature ageing in Gulf sun. AC environments dry skin down fast, which makes reapplication easy to skip — and that's exactly when UV damage compounds. Knowing the SPF number is only half the equation. Not medical advice, just the honest basics. Learn more at cliniclick.ae
